The Portland Blend

Wren & Oak Coffee Roasters' flagship Portland Blend costs $18 for a twelve-ounce bag, and ships within two business days of roasting. It is a medium roast built around washed Colombian beans, balanced with a small portion of natural-process Ethiopian for brightness. Buy now and your bag ships within two days of the next roast.

Guarantee

Every bag we sell is covered by a thirty-day freshness guarantee. If a bag ever tastes stale or off before the thirty days are up, we will replace it at no cost to you, no questions asked.
